# Android UI Builder

Instructions for Android UI development with XML layouts.

## When to use
- Creating Android activity or fragment layouts
- Building custom View or ViewGroup subclasses
- Working with ConstraintLayout, RecyclerView, or Material components

## Steps
1. Define layout in `res/layout/*.xml`
2. Reference in Activity/Fragment with `setContentView(R.layout.my_layout)`
3. Use ViewBinding or DataBinding for type-safe view access
